title: VaultScaffoldConfig
description: Configuration contract produced by the vault-scaffold interview and consumed by scripts/scaffold.py. Defines a single vault to be generated.

vault_name.description: Human-readable name of the vault. Used in generated README.md and CLAUDE.md headers.

target_path.description: Absolute filesystem path where the vault will be scaffolded. Must be absolute (POSIX '/...' or Windows 'X:\...' / 'X:/...').

domain.description: Primary subject domain of the vault. Drives which domain template (references/domain-templates.md) seeds the schema.

scope.description: Breadth of the vault. Appears in generated guidance; the starter uses the same folder layout for every scope.

audience.description: Who will read and maintain the vault. Recorded for the owner; the starter does not alter its workflows by audience.

categories.description: Page categories the vault will track (e.g., 'concepts', 'decisions', 'entities', 'sources'). MUST include 'sources' because ingest writes summaries into vault/sources/. Other categories seed index.md sections.

seed_artifacts.description: Optional paths or URLs offered for later ingest after source-access review. The scaffold does not ingest them automatically.

ingest_mode.description: Default interaction style for the generated ingest skill. 'confirm_each_step' prompts per page; 'confirm_plan' shows the plan once; 'autonomous' runs end-to-end.

custom_notes.description: Free-form local operating notes. Written to ignored LOCAL-NOTES.md and the ignored config snapshot, not to CLAUDE.md. Do not include secrets; an agent may read these notes. Empty string allowed.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (with timezone) marking when the config was produced.

scaffold_version.description: Semver version of the scaffolder that produced this config. Persisted into the vault for forward-compat checks.
